_note: Regions of the 4 MB expanded image that the new pipeline may write into. Banks $C0-$EF are the stock ROM and are never allocated from here; only the space gained by expanding 3 MB -> 4 MB is listed. Ranges are start-inclusive, end-exclusive PC offsets, matching the project-wide convention.

regions.purpose: token streams that do not fit their stock slot (script overflow, menus, catalogs)
precomposed cluster bitmaps and the metrics table
catalog records moved out of their stock bank, reached by repointed 24-bit descriptors
bank/page/bitmap tables that tell the adapter which ranges belong to us
long-jump landing pads for the stock engine hooks
unassigned; keep free until something needs it
